ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailunw yavma 'izil lil mukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقْكُمْ مِنْ مَاءٍ مَهِينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam naxlukkum mimmaaa'im mahiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizlarni haqir suvdan yaratmdikmi?

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَكِينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faja'alnaahu fiy qaraarim makiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, uni mustahkam qarorgohga joylamadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَعْلُومٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illaa qadrim ma'luum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ma'lum vaqtga qadar.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ الْقَادِرُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faqadarnaa fani'mal qaadiruun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Biz qodir bo'ldik va qandoq ham yaxshi qodir bo'luvchimiz.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma 'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqavchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam naj'alil arda kifaataa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yerni o'ziga tortuvchi qilmadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: أَحْيَاءً وَأَمْوَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ahyaaa'anw va amvaataa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tiriklarni va o'liklarni?

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمْ مَاءً فُرَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ja'alnaa fiyhaa ravaasiya shaamixaatinw va asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Biz unda yukasak tog'lar qildik va sizlarni zilol suv bilan sug'ordik.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma 'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Intaliquuo ilaa maa kuntum bihiy tukazzibuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yuringiz! O'zingiz yolg'onga chiqargan narsaga qarab.

ayahs.arabic: انْطَلِقُوا إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلَاثِ شُعَبٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Intaliquuo ilaa zillin ziy salaasi shu'ab.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yuringiz! Uchta sho''basi bor «soya»ga qarab.

ayahs.arabic: لَا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa zaliylinw va laa yug'niy minal lahab.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U salqin qiluvchimas va olovni ham qaytarmas.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَالْقَصْرِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahaa tarmiy bishararin kalqasr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta u.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَالَتٌ صُفْرٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ka annahuu jimaalatun sufr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U (uchqun) xuddi qoramtir-sarg'ish tuyalarga o'xshaydir.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma 'izil lilmukazibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنْطِقُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Haazaa yavmu laa uantiquun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bu ular gapira olmaydigan kundir.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziruun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va ularga uzr aytishga izn berilmaydir.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailunw yavma 'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَاكُمْ وَالْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Haaza yavmul fasli jama 'naakum val avwaliyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bu ajratish kuni, sizlarni va avvalgilarni jamladik.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنْ كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakiyduun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, sizlarning hiylangiz bo'lsa, menga ishlatib ko'ring-chi?

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَالٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal muttaqiyna fiy zilaalinw va 'uyuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta taqvodorlar soyalar va buloqlardadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va favaakiha mimmaa yastahuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va o'zlari xohlagan mevalardadir.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا هَنِيئًا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kuluu vashrabuu haniye 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maluun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yenglar va ichinglar, osh bo'lsin. Qilgan amallaringiz sababidandir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innaa kazaalika najzil muhsiniyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, Biz muhsinlarni shunday mukofotlarmiz.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma 'izil lilmuzkazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا وَتَمَتَّعُوا قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kuluu va tamatta'uu qaliylan innakum mujrimuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yenglar va mazza qilinglar, ozginagina. Albatta, sizlar gunohkorsizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailunny yavma 'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqavurchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ارْكَعُوا لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izaa qiyla lahumur ka'uu aa yarka'uun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va agar ularga ruku' qilinglar deyilsa, ruku' qilmaslar.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailunny yavma 'izil lilmukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilvarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fabi ayyi hadiysim ba'dahuu yu'minuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, undan keyin, qaysi so'zga ishonarlar?!

ayahs.arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَاءَلُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Amma Yatasaa-aluun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Nima haqida so'rashadi?

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ النَّبَإِ الْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Anin-nabaa-il 'aziym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ulkan, muhim xabar haqida (so'rashadi).

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allazi hum fiyhi mux talifuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Shunday xabarki, u.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaa sa y'alamuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Ular tezda bilarlar!

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa kallaa sa y'alamuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yana yo'q! Ular tezda bilarlar!

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ الْأَرْضَ مِهَادًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam naj'alil arda mihaa da.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yerni to'shab qo'ymadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: وَالْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val jibaala au taada.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tog'larni qoziq (qilib qo'ymadikmi?).

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَاكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va xalaq naakum azvaaja.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va sizlarni juft qilib yaratdik.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vaja'alnan naumakum subata.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va uyqularingizni rohat qilib qo'ydik.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا اللَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vaja'alnal laila libasa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va kechasini libos qilib qo'ydik.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا النَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vaja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va kunduzni tiriklik qildik.

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tepalarngizga yetti mustahkam (osmon)ni bino qildik.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vaja'alna siraajaw vah haaja.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va shu'la taratuvchi chiroq ham qildik.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ الْمُعْصِرَاتِ مَاءً ثَجَّاجًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va anzalna minal m'uSirooti maa-an saj-jaaja.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va siqilgan.

ayahs.arabic: لِنُخْرِجَ بِهِ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Linux rija bihiy habbaw vana baata.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(suv) bilan don va nabotot chiqarishimiz uchun.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va jan naatin alfafa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va daraxtlari bir-biriga kirishgan bo'stonlar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَاتًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, ajrim kuni vaqti belgilangan edi.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yauma yun faxu fis-suuri fataa tuuna afvaaja.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda surga puflanur va sizlar to'p-to'p bo'lib kelursizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ السَّمَاءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abvaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Osmon yorilib, eshik-eshiklar ochilur.

ayahs.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ الْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tog'lar o'rnidan ko'chirilib, sarobga aylanur.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, jahannam poylab turuvchi edi.

ayahs.arabic: لِلطَّاغِينَ مَآبًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Lit taa g'iyna ma aaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tug'yonga ketganlarga qaytar joydir.

ayahs.arabic: لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa bisiyna fiyhaa ahqaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular unda zamonlar bo'yi qoluvchilardir.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa ya zuuquuna fiyha bar daw valaa sharaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular unda sovuqni ham, sharobni ham tatiy olmaslar.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illa hamiy maw-va g'as saaqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Magar qaynoq suv va yiringni (tatirlar).

ayahs.arabic: جَزَاءً وِفَاقًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Jazaa-aw vi faaqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Muvofiq jazo o'laroq.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahum kaanu laa yarjuuna hisaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Chunki ular hisob-kitob bo'lishiga ishonmasdilar.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Bizning oyatlariimizni yolg'on deyishgan edi, yolg'on!.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Biz barcha narsani kitobga jamlab qo'yganmiz.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا فَلَنْ نَزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa zuuquu falan-naziy dakum ill-laa azaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, tatib ko'ringlar, sizlarga azobdan boshqa hech narsani ziyoda qilmasmiz.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna lil mutta qiyna mafaaza.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, taqvodorlarga yutuq bordir:.

ayahs.arabic: حَدَائِقَ وَأَعْنَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hadaa-iqa va a'anaa ba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bog'-rog'lar, uzumzorlar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va kaava 'iba at raaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va yangi bo'yi yetgan bir xil yoshdagi qizlar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ka'san di haaqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va to'ldirilgan qadahlar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa yasma'uuna fiha lag' vaw valaa kizzaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U yerda bekorchi gaplarni ham, yolg'on gaplarni ham eshitmaslar.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَاءً مِنْ رَبِّكَ عَطَاءً حِسَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Jazaa-am mir-Robbika ataa-an hisaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Robbingdan mukofot, sovg'a hisobidandir.

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Robbis samaa vaati val ardi va maa baina humar Rohmaani laa yam likuuna minhu xi taaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U osmonlar, yer va ularning orasidagi barcha narsalarning Robbisi, Rohmandir, Uning huzurida hech kim xitob qilishga qodir bo'lmas.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yauma yaquu mur ruuhu val malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla muuna illa man azina lahur Rohmaanu va qaala savaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'sha kunda Ruh va farishtalar saf bo'lib turadir. Rohman izn berganlar va to'g'ri so'zlaganlardan o'zgalar gapira olmaslar.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآبًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta xaaza ill-laa Robbihi ma-aaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U haq kundir. Kim xohlasa, o'z Robbisiga qaytar yo'l oladir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا أَنْذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِي كُنْتُ تُرَابًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: In naa anzar naakum azaaban qariybaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu va ya quulul-kaafiru yaa lai taniy kuntu turaaba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, Biz sizlarni yaqin kelajakdagi azobdan qo'rqitdik. U kunda, har kishi.

ayahs.arabic: وَالنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Van naazi 'aati g'arqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Shiddat bilan.

ayahs.arabic: وَالنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Van naa shi taati nashta.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yumshoqlik bilan.

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vass saabi-haati sabha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Suzib yuruvchi (farishta)lar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: فَالسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fass saabi qaati sabqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'zishda musobaqa qiluvchi (farishta)lar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: فَالْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fal mu dab-bi raati amra.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Amrning tadbirini qiluvchi (farishta)lar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yavma tarjufur raajifa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Iztirobga tushuvchi iztirobga tushgan kunda.

ayahs.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Tatba'u har raadifa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unga ergashuvchi ergashar.

ayahs.arabic: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Quluubuny-yau maaiziw-vaaji-fa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'sha kunda qalblar xavfga to'lar.

ayahs.arabic: أَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Absaa ruhaa xashi'ah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ularning ko'zlari qo'rqinchga to'lar.

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَإِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِي الْحَافِرَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ya quu luuna a-inna lamar duu duuna fil haafirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular: «Biz ortga qaytarilamizmi?

ayahs.arabic: أَإِذَا كُنَّا عِظَامًا نَخِرَةً
ayahs.uzbekReading: Aizaa kunna 'izaa man-naxirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Chirigan suyak bo'lganimizdan keyin ham-a?

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Qaalu tilka izan karratun xaasirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Agar shundoq bo'lsa, bu hasratiy qaytish-ku?» derlar.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-vaahida.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, u.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا هُمْ بِالسَّاهِرَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faizaa hum biss saahirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ko'ribsizki, ular qiyomat maydonida turibdi-da.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hal ataaka hadiysu Musaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Senga Musoning xabari keldimi?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَاهُ رَبُّهُ بِالْوَادِ الْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.uzbekReading: Iz nadaahu Robbuhu bil vaadil-muqad dasi tuva.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qachonki Robbisi unga muqaddas Tuva vodiysida nido qildi:.

ayahs.arabic: اذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu tag'aa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: «Fir'avn huzuriga bor, albatta u tug'yonga ketdi.

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَىٰ أَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas unga ayt: «Senda poklanishga (rag'bat) bormi?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ahdi yaka ila Robbika fatax sha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va seni Robbingga hidoyat qilsam, shoyadki (Undan) qo'rqsang», deb»

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَاهُ الْآيَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa araahul-aayatal kubra.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va unga ulkan alomatni ko'rsatdi.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa kazzaba va asaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ul uni yolg'onga chiqardi va osiy bo'ldi.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa adbara yas'aa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ng ortiga o'girilib tezlab ketdi¬.

ayahs.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa hashara fanada.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Keyin (odamlarni) to'plab nido qildi.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا رَبُّكُمُ الْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faqala ana Robbu kumul-a'laa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, men sizlarning eng oliy Robbingizman, dedi.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ اللَّهُ نَكَالَ الْآخِرَةِ وَالْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa-axa zahul laahu nakalal aaxirati val-uula.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas Alloh uni avvalgi va oxirgi gunohlari uchun azobga oldi.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِمَنْ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna fiy zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, bunda qo'rqadiganlar uchun ibrat bordir.

ayahs.arabic: أَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ السَّمَاءُ ۚ بَنَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: A-antum a shaddu xalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizlarni yaratish qiyinmi yoki U zot bino qilgan osmonnimi?

ayahs.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Raf'a sam kaha fasaw vaaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uning shiftini yuqori ko'tardi va bekamu ko'st, mustahkam qilib qo'ydi.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ag'tasha lailaha va axraja duhaaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Kechasini qorong'u va kunduzini yorug' qildi.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va undan so'ng yerni tuxum shaklida qildi.

ayahs.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَاءَهَا وَمَرْعَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Axraja minha maa-aha va mar 'aaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Undan suvni, o't-o'lanlarni chiqardi.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْجِبَالَ أَرْسَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val jibala arsaaha.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tog'larni sobit qildi.

ayahs.arabic: مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Mataa'al lakum vali an 'aamikum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizlarga va chorvalaringizga manfaat bo'lsin uchun.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الطَّامَّةُ الْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki katta g'olib (qiyomat) kelsa.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yauma Yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kuni inson qilgan ishlarini eslaydir.

ayahs.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ الْجَحِيمُ لِمَنْ يَرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va burrizatil-jahiymu limany-yaraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va jahannam ko'radiganlarga zohir qilinadir.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ammaa man tag'aa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo kimiki tug'yonga ketib, haddidan oshgan bo'lsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَآثَرَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va aasaral hayaatad dunyaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va bu dunyo hayotini ustun qo'ygan bo'lsa,.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ الْجَحِيمَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa innal jahiyma hiyal maavaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, albatta, Jahiym o'rin bo'ladir.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفْسَ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ammaa man xaafa maqaama Robbihiy va nahan nafsa 'anil havaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, ammo kim Robbisining maqomidan qo'rqqan va o'z nafsini havolanib ketishidan qaytargan bo'lsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ الْجَنَّةَ هِيَ الْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa innal jannata hiyal maavaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, albatta, jannat o'rin bo'ladir.

ayahs.arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yas'aluunaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sendan, qiyomat qachon bo'lur? deb so'rarlar.

ayahs.arabic: فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْرَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiyma anta min zikraahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uning zikrini sen qandoq bilarding.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ilaa Robbika muntahaa haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uning intihosi Robbingga xosdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُنْذِرُ مَنْ يَخْشَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta sen un.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ka annahum Yavma yaravnahaa lam yalbasuuo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uni ko'rgan kunlari xuddi bu dunyoda bir kecha yoki kunduzdan boshqa turmaganga o'xsharlar.

ayahs.arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Abasa va tavallaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Aftini burishtirdi va yuz o'girdi.

ayahs.arabic: أَنْ جَاءَهُ الْأَعْمَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: An jaa-ahul 'a-maa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ko'zi ko'r kishi huzuriga kelganda.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa yudriyka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qayerdan bilasan, ehtimol, u poklanar.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنْفَعَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yoki nasihat olar va mav'iza unga manfaat berar.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ اسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Amma manis tag'naa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo istig'no qilganga bo'lsa...

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنْتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa-anta lahu tasaddaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sen u tomonga intilasan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U poklanmasa, seni hech kim malomat qilmas.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ جَاءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va amma man jaa-aka yas'a.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo huzuringga shoshilib kelgan.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vahuva yaxshaa,.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va (Allohdan) qo'rqqan holda bo'lgandan esa...

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنْتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa-anta 'anhu talah haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Sen undan mashg'ul bo'lasan.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kalla innaha tazkirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Albatta u(oyat)lar eslatmadir.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنْ شَاءَ ذَكَرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faman shaa a zakarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Kim xohlasa uni eslaydir.

ayahs.arabic: فِي صُحُفٍ مُكَرَّمَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fi suhufim mukar rama,.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Hurmatlangan sahifalardadir.

ayahs.arabic: مَرْفُوعَةٍ مُطَهَّرَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Marfuu'atim mutah hara,.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Oliy qadardirlar, poklangandirlar.

ayahs.arabic: بِأَيْدِي سَفَرَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Bi'aidiy safara.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Elchi(farishta)lar qo'llaridadir.

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامٍ بَرَرَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kiraamim bararah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular hurmatlangan va o'ta yaxshidirlar.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ الْإِنْسَانُ مَا أَكْفَرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Qutilal-insanu maa akfarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: (Kofir) insonga la'nat bo'lsin, uning kofirligi qandoq shiddatli bo'ldi.

ayahs.arabic: مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Min aiyyi shai-in Xalaq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uni qaysi narsadan yaratdi?

ayahs.arabic: مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُ فَقَدَّرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Min nutfah; xalaqahu faqad-darah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Nutfadan yaratdi. Uni yaratdi va unni o'lchovli qildi.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ السَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summas sabiyla yas-sarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra chiqish yo'lini oson qildi.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُ فَأَقْبَرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa amatahu fa-aqbarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra o'ldirdi va qabrga kiritdi.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ أَنْشَرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa iza shaa-a ansharah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra qachon xohlasa, uni qayta tiriltiradi.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q undoq emas! U o'ziga U zot qilgan amrni bajarmadi.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Inson o'z taomiga nazar solsin.

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا الْمَاءَ صَبًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, Biz suvni rosa quyib qo'ydik.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra yerni o'ziga xos yordik.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ambatna fiyha habba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Biz unda don o'stirib qo'ydik.

ayahs.arabic: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va 'inabaw-va qadba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va uzum va ko'klarni ham.

ayahs.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va zaituunaw vanax la'.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va zaytun va xurmolarni ham.

ayahs.arabic: وَحَدَائِقَ غُلْبًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va hadaa-iqa g'ulba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tig'iz bog'larni ham.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَاكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va faki hataw-va abba.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va mevalarni va o't-o'lanlarni ham.

ayahs.arabic: مَتَاعًا لَكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَامِكُمْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Mata'al-lakum va li-an'amikum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizlarga va chorvalaringizga manfaat bo'lsin, deb.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faiza jaa-atis saaxah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki quloqlarni kar qiluvchi ovoz kelsa.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yauma yafir-rul mar-u min axiyh.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda kishi qochadir; o'z aka-ukasidan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمِّهِ وَأَبِيهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ummihiy va abiyh.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va onasi va otasidan.

ayahs.arabic: وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va sahi batihiy va baniyh.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va xotini va bola-chaqasidan.

ayahs.arabic: لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yug'niyh.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda ulardan har bir shaxsni ovora qiluvchi o'z ishi bor.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُسْفِرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vujuu huny-yauma-izim-musfira;.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda porloq chehralar bor.

ayahs.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Dahi katum mustab shirah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular kulgu bilan to'la, yetgan xushxabardan xursand.

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va vujuuhuy yauma-izin 'alaiha g'abar a.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda g'ubor bosgan chehralar bor.

ayahs.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Tarhaquha qatarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ustini zulmat qoplagan.

ayahs.arabic: أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْكَفَرَةُ الْفَجَرَةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular, ana o'shalar, kofirlar va fojirlardir.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izash shamsu kuvwirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki, quyoshni buklab, o'ralsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izan nujuumun kadarat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, yulduzlar sochilib ketsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal jibaalu suyyirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, tog'lar sayr qildirilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, homilasiga o'n oy to'lgan tuyalar qarovsiz qolsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal vuhuushu hushirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, vahshiy hayvonlar bir joyga to'plansa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal bihaaru sujjirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, dengizlar alanga olib yonsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا النُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izan nufuusu zuvwijat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va vaqtiki, nafslar juftlashtirilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal maw'uudatu su'ilat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va vaqtiki, tiriklay ko'milgan qizdan so'ralsa.

ayahs.arabic: بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Bi ayyi zambin qutilat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U nima gunoh uchun o'ldirilgan?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izas suhufu nushirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, sahifalar nashr qilinsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا السَّمَاءُ كُشِطَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izas samaaa'u kushitat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, osmon qo'porilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal jahiymu su'-'irat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, jahannam qizdirilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal jannatu uzlifat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, jannat yaqinlashtirilsa.

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا أَحْضَرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Har bir jon nima hozirlanganini biladi.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالْخُنَّسِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Falaaa uqsimu bil xunnas.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: (Kunduzi) maxfiy bo'luvchi(yulduz)lar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: الْجَوَارِ الْكُنَّسِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Al javaaril kunnas.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: (Kechalari) yuruvchi, berkinuvchi(yulduz)lar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaili izaa 'as'as.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qorong'uligi bilan kirib kelgan kecha bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vassubhi izaa tanaffas.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Nafas olib, kirib kelgan tong bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu laqavlu rasuulin kariym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta u.

ayahs.arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِنْدَ ذِي الْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ziy quvwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U quvvatlidir. Arsh egasi huzurida martabasi oliydir.

ayahs.arabic: مُطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Mutaa'in samma amiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Itoat qilingan, omonatli.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa saahibukum bimajnuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizning sohibingiz majnun emas.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِالْأُفُقِ الْمُبِينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq ul ani ochiq-oydin ufqda ko'rdi.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى الْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa huva 'alal g'aibi bidaniyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u g'aybga baxil emas.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَجِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa huva biqavli shaitaanir rajiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ayna tazhabuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, qayoqqa ketmoqdasiz?!

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: In huva illaa zikrul lil'aalamiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U (Qur'on) olamlarga eslatmadan boshqa narsa emas.

ayahs.arabic: لِمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sizlardan mustaqim bo'lishni xohlovchilar uchun.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa tashaaa'uuna illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu Robbul 'Aalamiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Olamlarning Robbisi Alloh xohlamasa, sizlar xohlay olmassizlar.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izas samaaa'un fatarat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki, osmon yorilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْكَوَاكِبُ انْتَثَرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal kavaakibun tasarat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, yulduzlar sochilib ketsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal bihaaru fujjirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, dengizlar portlatilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal qubuuru bu'sirat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, qabrlar ostin-ustin bo'lsa.

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Alimat nafsum maa qaddamat va axxarat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Har bir jon nimani taqdim qildiyu, nimani ta'xir qildi- biladi.

ayahs.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa g'arraka bi Robbikal kariym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ey Inson! Seni karamli Robbing haqida nima g'ururga ketkazdi?!

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy xalaqaka fasaw vaaka fa'adalak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U seni to'la-to'kis va mo''tadil qilib yaratgan zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: فِي أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَا شَاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiye ayye suuratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'zi xohlagan suratda seni tarkib qildi.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِالدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kalla bal tukazzibuuna bid diyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Balki, siz jazoni yolg'onga chiqarmoqdasiz!

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va inna 'alaikum lahaa fiziyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Holbuki, ustingizdan kuzatib turuvchilar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامًا كَاتِبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kiraaman kaatibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular hurmatli, yozib turguvchilardir.

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ya'lamuuna ma taf'aluun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular nima qilayotganingizni biladir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal abraara lafiy na'iym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, yaxshilar jannatdadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ الْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va innal fujjaara lafiy jahiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va albatta, fojirlar jahannamdadir.

ayahs.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ الدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaslavnahaa Yavmad Diyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular u yerga qiyomat kuni kiradir.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَائِبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa hum 'anhaa big'aaa 'ibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va ular undan g'oyib bo'la olmaydir.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maaa adraaka maa Yavmud Diyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va jazo kuni nima ekanini senga nima bildirdi?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ الدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa maaa adraaka maa Yavmud Diyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ng jazo kuni nima ekanini senga nima bildirdi?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئًا ۖ وَالْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yavma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw valamru yavma'izil lillaah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'sha kunda hech bir jon boshqa bir jon uchun biror narsa qilish imkoniga molik emasdir. U kunda barcha ish Allohning O'ziga xosdir.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ لِلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailul lil mutaffifiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vayl.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِينَ إِذَا اكْتَالُوا عَلَى النَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziyna izak taaluu 'alan naasi yastavfuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular odamlardan narsa o'lchab olsalar, to'liq olarlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izaa kaaluuhum aw vazanuuhum yuxsiruun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va agar odamlarga o'lchab yoki tortib bersalar, kamaytirarlar.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُولَٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'uusuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ana shular, albatta, qayta tiriltirilishlarini o'ylamaydilarmi?

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Li Yavmin 'Aziym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ulug' bir kunda.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yavma yaquumun naasu li Robbil 'aalamiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunda, odamlar olamlar Robbisi huzurida tik turarlar.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafiy Sijjiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Albatta fojirlarlarning kitobi «sijjin»dadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa adraaka maa Sijjiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: «Sijjin» qanday narsa ekanini senga nima bildirdi?!

ayahs.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kitaabum marquum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U yozilgan kitobdur.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vailuny yavma'izil lil mukazzibiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'sha kunda yolg'onga chiqaruvchilarga vayl bo'lsin!

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ الدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziyna yukazzibuuna bi yavmid diyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular jazo kunini yolg'onga chiqararlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa yukazzibu bihiye illaa kullu mu'tadin asiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U kunni haddan oshuvchi va o'ta gunohkorlardan boshqalar yolg'onga chiqarmaslar.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaatiyrul avwaliyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qachon unga oyatlarimiz tilovat qilinsa, «avalgilarning afsonalari», der.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quluubihim maa kaanuu yaksibuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Ularning qilgan kasblari qalblariga mog'or bo'lib o'rnashib qolgan, xolos.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Robbihim yavma'izil lamah juubuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Albatta, ular o'sha kunda o'z Robbilarini ko'rishdan to'silarlar.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُو الْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa innahum lasaa lul jahiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra ular albatta jahiymga kiruvchidirlar.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa yuqaalu haazal laziy kuntum bihiy tukazzibuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra, mana bu, sizlar yolg'onga chiqarib yurgan narsa, deyilar.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا إِنَّ كِتَابَ الْأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafiy'Illiyyiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Albatta abrorlarning kitobi «Illiyyun»dadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maaa adraaka maa 'Illiyyuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: «Illiyyun» qandoq narsa ekanini senga nima bildirdi?!

ayahs.arabic: كِتَابٌ مَرْقُومٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kitaabum marquum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U yozilgan kitobdur.

ayahs.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yashhadu hul muqarra buun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unga muqarrab(farishta)lar shohid bo'larlar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal abraara lafiy Na'iym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, abrorlar jannati nayimdadirlar.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuruun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Pardali baland so'rilar ustida nazar solib turarlar.

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ النَّعِيمِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ta'rifu fiy vujuuhihim nadratan na'iym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ularning chehralaridan jannat ravnaqini bilib olarsan.

ayahs.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِنْ رَحِيقٍ مَخْتُومٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yusqavna mir rahiyqim maxtuum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular muhrlangan, nihoyatda pok, sharobdan icharlar.

ayahs.arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ الْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Xitaamuhuu misk; va fiy zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(sharob)ning xotimasi miskdir. Va shu narsa uchun musobaqa qiluvchilar musobaqa qilsinlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِنْ تَسْنِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va mizaajuhuu min Tasniym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(sharob)ning aralashmasi «tasnim»dandir.

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا الْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarrabuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(Tasnim) bir buloqdirki, undan muqarrablar icharlar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا كَانُوا مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal laziyna ajramuu kaanuu minal laziyna aamanuu yazakuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta jinoyat qilganlar iymon keltirganlar ustidan kular edilar.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izaa marruu bihim yatag'aamazuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Agar ul.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ انْقَلَبُوا فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izan qalabuuo ilaaa ahlihimun qalabuu fakihiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Agar u.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوا إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَضَالُّونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izaa ra avhum qaaluuo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal luun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va agar u.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أُرْسِلُوا عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maaa ursiluu 'alaihim haafiziyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Holbuki, ular a.

ayahs.arabic: فَالْيَوْمَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنَ الْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fal yavmal laziyna aamanuu minal kuffaari yazakuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Endi, bu Kunda iymon keltirganlar kofirlar ustidan kularlar.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ يَنْظُرُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Alal araaa'iki yanzuruun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Pardali, baland so'rilar ustida nazar solib turarlar.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ الْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hal suvwibal kuffaaru maa kaanuu yaf'aluun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Kofirlar qilgan ishlarining «savobini» olar mikanlar?!

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izas samaaa'un shaqqat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki, osmon yorilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va azinat li Robbihaa va huqqat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا الْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izal ardu muddat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, vaqtiki, yer cho'zilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va alqat maa fiyhaa va taxallat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va o'z ichidagi narsalarni otib chiqarib, xoli qolsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va azinat li Robbihaa va huqqat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u.

ayahs.arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Robbika kad han famulaaqiyh.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ey inson! Albatta sen Robbingga yo'liqquningcha, harakatu urinishda bo'larsan va oxiri unga yo'liqarsan.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ammaa man uutiya kitaabahuu biyamiynih.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo kimning kitobi o'ng tarafdan berilsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fasavfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yasiyraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tezda, osongina hisob qilinar.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَنْقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihiy masruuraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va ahli huzuriga xursand holda qaytib borar.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ammaa man uutiya kitaabahuu varaaa'a zahrih.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, ammo, kimning kitobi orqa tarafdan berilsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُو ثُبُورًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fasavfa yad'uu subuuraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U tezda o'ziga halokatni chaqirar.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va yaslaa sa'iyraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va qizib turgan do'zaxga kirar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُورًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu kaana fiye ahlihiy masruuraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Chunki, u.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ يَحُورَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu zanna al lai yahuur.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Chunki, u hech qachon orqaga qaytmaslikni o'ylagan edi.

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Balaaa inna Robbahuu kaana bihiy basiyraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ha! Albatta, Robbisi uni doim ko'rib turuvchi edi.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا أُقْسِمُ بِالشَّفَقِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Shafaq bilan qasamki.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaili va maa vasaq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Kechasi va u o'rab olgan narsalar bilan qasamki.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا اتَّسَقَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Valqamari izat tasaq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va to'lin oy bilan qasamki.

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَنْ طَبَقٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, sizlar tabaqama-tabaqa minasizlar.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Famaa lahum laa yu'minuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Nima bo'lgan ularga, iymon keltirmaslar?!

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va izaa quri'a 'alaihimul Quraanu laa yasjuduun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va agar ularga Qur'on o'qilsa, sajda qilmaslar?!

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Balil laziyna kafaruu yukazzibuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Balki kofirlar yolg'onga chiqararlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaahu a'lamu bimaa yuu'uun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular qalblarida nimani saqlayotganlarini Allohning O'zi bilar.

ayahs.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aliym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ularga alamli azobning «bashoratini» ber.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illal laziyna aamanuu va 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun g'airu mamnuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Magar iymon keltirganlarga va yaxshi amallar qilganlarga, ularga minnatsiz, uzluksiz ajrlar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الْبُرُوجِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vassamaaa'i zaatil buruuj.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Burjlar egasi bo'lgan osmon bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْيَوْمِ الْمَوْعُودِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val yavmil maw'uud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va va'da qilingan kun bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va shaahidinw va mashhuud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Guvohlik beruvchi va guvohlik berilgan bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ الْأُخْدُودِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Qutila as haabul uxduud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: «Uxdud» egalariga la'nat bo'lsin.

ayahs.arabic: النَّارِ ذَاتِ الْوَقُودِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Annaari zaatil vaquud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U (Uxdud) yoqilg'isi ko'p, qattiq isigan olovdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Iz hum 'alaihaa qu'uud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(kofir)lar a(chuqur)lar atrofida o'tiribdilar.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va hum 'alaa maa yaf'aluuna bilmu 'miniyna shuhuud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va ular mo'minlarga qilayotgan narsalariga o'zlari hozirdirlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا مِنْهُمْ إِلَّا أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa naqamuu minhum illaaa aiyu'minuu billaahil 'aziyzil Hamiyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va (ular) mo'minlardan Aziz, Hamid Allohga bo'lgan iymondan boshqa «ayb» topa olmadilar.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ ۚ وَاللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy lahuu mulkus samaavaati val ard; vallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shahiyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U shunday zotki, osmonlaru yerning mulki Unga xosdir va Alloh har bir narsaga O'zi guvohdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal laziyna fatanul mu'miniyna val mu'minaati summa lam yatuubuu falahum 'azaabu Jahannama va lahum 'azaabul hariyq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, mo'min va mo'minalarni fitna qilib, so'ngra tavba qilmaganlarga, ana o'shalarga, jahannam azobi va kuydiruvchi azob bor.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innal laziyna aamanuu va 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajriy min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal favzul kabiyr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, iymon keltirgan va solih amal qilganlarga, ularga, ostidan anhorlar oqib turgan jannat bor. Bu esa nihoyatda ulkan yutuqdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna batsha Robbika lashadiyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, Robbingning changali juda ham shiddatlidir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu Huva yubdi'u va yu'iyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, U O'zi boshlar va qaytarar.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الْوَدُودُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va Huval G'afuurul Vaduud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va U mag'firat qiluvchi, muhabbati zo'r zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: ذُو الْعَرْشِ الْمَجِيدُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Zul 'Arshil Majiyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U Arsh egasi hamda qadri ulug' zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: فَعَّالٌ لِمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa' 'aalul limaa yuriyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U nimani xohlasa, qila oluvchi zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْجُنُودِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hal ataaka hadiysul junuud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Senga askarlarning xabari keldimi?

ayahs.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fir'avna va Samuud.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Fir'avn va Samudning.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي تَكْذِيبٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Balil laziyna kafaruu fiy takziyb.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Balki kofirlar yolg'onga chiqarishdadir?

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّهُ مِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ مُحِيطٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaahu minw varaaa'ihim muhiyt.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Holbuki, Alloh ularning ortidan ihota qilib turuvchidir.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْآنٌ مَجِيدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Bal huva Quraanum Majiyd.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! U Qur'oni majiddur.

ayahs.arabic: فِي لَوْحٍ مَحْفُوظٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiy Lavhim Mahfuuz.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U Lavhul- Mahfuzdadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vassamaaa'i vattaariq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Osmon bilan qasam va toriq bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الطَّارِقُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maaa adraaka mattaariq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Toriq nimaligini senga ne bildirdi?

ayahs.arabic: النَّجْمُ الثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Annajmus saaqib.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U nur sochib turuvchi yulduzdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: In kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Hech bir jon yo'qki, uning hifz qilib turuvchisi bo'lmasa.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنْظُرِ الْإِنْسَانُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fal yanzuril insaanu mimma xuliq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Inson nimadan yaralganiga nazar solsin.

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ مِنْ مَاءٍ دَافِقٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Xuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U otilib chiquvchi suvdan yaratilgandir.

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ الصُّلْبِ وَالتَّرَائِبِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaxruju mim bainissulbi vat taraaa'ib.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U (suv) sulb (umurtqa) va taroib (ko'krak suyagi) orasidan chiqadir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِ لَقَادِرٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu 'alaa raj'ihiy laqaadir.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta U zot uni qayta tiriltirishga qodirdir.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى السَّرَائِرُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yavma tublas saraaa'ir.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sirlar fosh bo'ladigan kundadir.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Famaa lahuu min quvwatinw va laa naasir.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas,.

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ ذَاتِ الرَّجْعِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vassamaaa'i zaatir raj'.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qaytuvchi.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ الصَّدْعِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val ardi zaatis sad'.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yorib chiquvchi egasi bo'lgan yer bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahuu laqavlun fasl.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta u(Qur'on) ajratuvchi so'zdir.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِالْهَزْلِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa huva bil hazl.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u hazil emasdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innahum yakiyduuna kaidaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta ular hiyla-nayrang qilarlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va akiydu kaidaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Men ham hiyla qilurman.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ الْكَافِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Famahhilil kaafiriyna amhilhum ruvaidaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Muhlat ber kofirlarga, ularga ozgina muhlat ber.

ayahs.arabic: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى
ayahs.uzbekReading: Sabbihisma Robbikal A'laa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Oliy qadar bo'lgan Robbing ismini poklab yod et.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy xalaqa fasavwaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U yaratgan va mutanosib qilgan zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالَّذِي قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaziy qaddara fahadaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U o'lchovli qilgan va hidoyatga boshlagan zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الْمَرْعَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaziye axrajal mar'aa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U o't-o'lanni chiqargan zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُ غُثَاءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faja'alahuu g'usaaa'an ahvaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, U uni qoraygan xashak qilgan zotdir.

ayahs.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنْسَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Biz senga qiroat qildiramiz, bas, esdan chiqarmayssan.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ يَعْلَمُ الْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahuu ya'lamul jahra va maa yaxfaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Magar Alloh xohlaganini. Albatta, U oshkorni ham, maxfiy narsani ham biladir.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va nu-yassiruka lilyusraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va seni oson yo'lga muyassar qilarmiz.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنْ نَفَعَتِ الذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, agar eslatish manfaat bersa, eslatgin.

ayahs.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَنْ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Sa yazzakkaru maiyaxshaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, qo'rqqan esga oladir.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا الْأَشْقَى
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va yatajannabuhal ashqaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va badbaxt undan chetda bo'ladir.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي يَصْلَى النَّارَ الْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy yaslan Naaral kubraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U katta olovga kiradir.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa laa yamuutu fiyhaa va laa yahyaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra uning ichida o'lmay ham, tirilmay ham qoladir.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Qad aflaha man tazakkaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq, kim pok bo'lsa, yutuq topadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكَرَ اسْمَ رَبِّهِ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va zakaras ma Robbihiy fasallaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Robbisi ismini zikr qilsa va namoz o'qisa hamdir.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Bal tu'siruunal hayaatad dunyaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Lekin, sizlar dunyo hayotini ustun qo'yasizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val Aaxiratu xairunw va abqaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Holbuki, oxirat yaxshiroq va boqiyroqdir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِي الصُّحُفِ الْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil uulaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, bu avvalgi sahifalarda bordir.

ayahs.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Suhufi Ibraahiyma va Muusaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ibrohim va Muso sahifalaridadir.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَاكَ حَدِيثُ الْغَاشِيَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hal ataaka hadiysul g'aashiyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq senga g'oshiya xabari keldi.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَاشِعَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vujuuhuny yavma 'izin xaashi'ah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda bir chehralar qo'rquvchidir.

ayahs.arabic: عَامِلَةٌ نَاصِبَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: 'Aamilatun naasibah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular amal qiluvi va charchavchidir.

ayahs.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
ayahs.uzbekReading: Taslaa naaran haamiyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular o'ta qizigan olovga kirarlar.

ayahs.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ آنِيَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular qaynab turgan buloqdan sug'orilarlar.

ayahs.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ ضَرِيعٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min dariy'.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ularga tikandan boshqa taom yo'q.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِي مِنْ جُوعٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa yusminu va laa yug'niy min juu'.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U na semirtirmas va na ochlikni ketkazmas.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَاعِمَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vujuuhuny yavma 'izin naa'imah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'shal kunda bir chehralar ne'matlanuvchidir.

ayahs.arabic: لِسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Lisa'yihaa raadiyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular o'z ishlaridan rozidir.

ayahs.arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiy jannatin 'aaliyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular oliy jannatdadir.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَاغِيَةً
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa tasma'u fiyhaa laag'iyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unda ular bekorchi gapni eshitmasdir.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiyhaa 'aynun jaariyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unda oqib turgan buloqlar bor.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَرْفُوعَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fiyhaa sururum marfuu'ah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unda baland-baland so'rilar bor.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَوْضُوعَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va akvaabum mavduu 'ah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tayyorlab qo'yilgan qadahlar bor.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va namaariqu masfuufah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va saf-saf tizilgan yostiqlar bor.

ayahs.arabic: وَزَرَابِيُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va zaraabiyyu mabsuusah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Hamma yoqqa to'shalgan gilamlar bor.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنْظُرُونَ إِلَى الْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Afalaa yanzuruuna ilalibili kaifa xuliqat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular nazar solmaslarmi; Tuyaning qanday yaratilganiga?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى السَّمَاءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va osmonni qandoq ko'tarilganiga?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى الْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tog'larning qandoq o'rnashtirilganiga?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى الْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ilal ardi kaifa sutihat.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va yerni qandoq tekislab qo'yilganiga?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fazakkir innama anta Muzakkir.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, eslatgin, sen, albatta, eslatuvchidirsan.

ayahs.arabic: لَسْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sen ular ustidan hukmingni o'tkazuvchi emassan.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illaa man tavallaa va kafar.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Lekin, kim yuz o'girsa va kofir bo'lsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ اللَّهُ الْعَذَابَ الْأَكْبَرَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, uni Alloh katta azob bilan azoblaydir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَا إِيَابَهُمْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta ularning qaytishi Bizgadir.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُمْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra, albatta, ularning hisob-kitobi ham Bizdadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْفَجْرِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val-Fajr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Fajr bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va layaalin 'ashr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va o'n kecha bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالشَّفْعِ وَالْوَتْرِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vash shaf'i val vatr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Juftu toq bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaili izaa yasr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va yurilgan tun bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذِي حِجْرٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Hal fiy zaalika qasamul liziy hijr.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Mana shularda aql egasi uchun.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala Robbuka bi'aad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sen Robbing Odga qanday.

ayahs.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ الْعِمَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Iramaa zaatil 'imaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Baland ustunli «Iram»ga.

ayahs.arabic: الَّتِي لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِي الْبِلَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allatiy lam yuxlaq misluhaa fil bilaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uning misli boshqa diyorlarda xalq qilinmaganga.

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودَ الَّذِينَ جَابُوا الصَّخْرَ بِالْوَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va samuudal laziyna jaabus saxra bil vaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va vodiyda xarsang toshlarni kesgan Samudga.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِي الْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va fir'avna zil avtaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va ko'p askarlari bor Fir'avnga.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِينَ طَغَوْا فِي الْبِلَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziyna tag'aw fil bilaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular turli o'lkalarda tug'yonga ketgan edilar.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا فِيهَا الْفَسَادَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa aksaruu fiyhal fasaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ular u.

ayahs.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fasabba 'alaihim Robbuka savta 'azaab.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Robbing ularning boshiga turli azoblarni quydi.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna Robbaka labil mirsaad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, Robbing kuzatib turuvchidir.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْإِنْسَانُ إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكْرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu Robbuhuu fa akramahuu va na' 'amahuu fa yaquulu Robbiye akraman.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, qachon insonni Robbisi sinash uchun ikrom qilsa va ne'mat bersa: «Meni Robbim ikrom qildi», deydir.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا إِذَا مَا ابْتَلَاهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّي أَهَانَنِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahuu fa yaquulu Robbiye ahaanan.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, qachon Robbisi sinash uchun rizqini tor qilib qo'ysa: «Robbim meni xorladi», deydir.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ لَا تُكْرِمُونَ الْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kalla bal laa tukrimuuo nal yatiym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Balki Sizlar yetimlarni ikrom qilmassizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَحَاضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ الْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va laa tahaaadduuna 'alaata'aamil miskiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bir-biringizni miskinlarga taom berishga undamassizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَمًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va taakuluunat turaasa aklal lammaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va merosni shiddatla yeysizlar.

ayahs.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ الْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va tuhibbuunal maala hubban jammaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va molni ko'p yaxshi ko'rasizlar.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا إِذَا دُكَّتِ الْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yo'q! Vaqtiki, yer zilzilaga tushib parcha-parcha bo'lib ketsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَاءَ رَبُّكَ وَالْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va jaaa'a Robbuka val malaku saffan saffaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Robbing va farishtalar saf-saf bo'lib kelsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَجِيءَ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الْإِنْسَانُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va jiye'a yavma'izim bi jahannnam; Yavma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu va annaa lahuz zikraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va o'sha kunda jahannamni keltirilsa, o'sha kunda inson eslaydir. Lekin bu eslashdan endi ne foyda?!

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ يَا لَيْتَنِي قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِي
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaquulu yaa laitaniy qaddamtu lihayaatiy.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U, afsuski,.

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa Yavma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahuuo ahad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, o'sha kunda Allohning azobiga o'xshash azobla hech kim azoblamas.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va laa yuusiqu vasaaqa huuo ahad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Uning bog'lashiga o'xshash hech kim bog'lamas.

ayahs.arabic: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ey xotirjam nafs!

ayahs.arabic: ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً
ayahs.uzbekReading: Irji'iye ilaa Robbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Robbingga sen Undan, U sendan rozi bo'lgan holingda qayt!

ayahs.arabic: فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fadxuliy fiy 'ibaadiy.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, bandalarim ichiga kirgin!

ayahs.arabic: وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vadxuliy jannatiy.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va jannatimga kirgin!

ayahs.arabic: لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Mana shu shahar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنْتَ حِلٌّ بِهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va anta hillum bihaazal balad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sen muqim turgan bu shaharla.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va vaalidinw va maa valad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va volid va undan tarqagan valadlar bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي كَبَدٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laqad xalaqnal insaana fiy kabad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq, Biz insonni mashaqqatda yaratdik.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَنْ يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U inson unga hech kimning kuchi yetmaydi, deb hisoblaydimi?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُبَدًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yaquulu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U, ko'plab mol-dunyo nafaqa qildim, deydir.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ayahsabu al lam yarahuuo ahad.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U inson uni birov ko'rmadi, deb o'ylaydimi?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَهُ عَيْنَيْنِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam naj'al lahuu 'aynayn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Biz unga ikki ko'zni bermadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va lisaananw va shafatayn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tilni va ikki labni (bermadikmi?).

ayahs.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُ النَّجْدَيْنِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va hadaynaahun najdayn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Biz uni ikki:.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا اقْتَحَمَ الْعَقَبَةَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Falaq tahamal-'aqabah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, u dovon oshib o'tmadi.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ مَا الْعَقَبَةُ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maaa adraaka mal'aqabah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Dovon qandoq narsa ekanini senga nima bildirdi?

ayahs.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fakku raqabah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U qul ozod qilishdir.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Aw it'aamun fiy yavmin ziy masg'abah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yoki ocharchilik kunida taom berishdir.

ayahs.arabic: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Yatiyman zaa maqrabah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Qarindosh yetimlarga.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Aw miskiynan zaa matrabah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Yoki tuproqqa qorigan miskinlarga.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa kaana minal laziyna aamanuu va tavaasaw bissabri va tavaasaw bilmarhamah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra iymon keltirganlar va bir-birini sabrga, mehr-shafqatga chaqirganlar bo'lsa.

ayahs.arabic: أُولَٰئِكَ أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ulaaa'ika As-haabul maimanah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ana o'shalar o'ng tomon egalaridir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaziyna kafaruu bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul Mash'amah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Oyatlarimizga kufr keltirganlar, ular, chap tomon egalaridir.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُؤْصَدَةٌ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alaihim naarum mu'sadah.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ularni chiqib bo'lmaydigan o't-olov o'rab olgandir.

ayahs.arabic: وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vash shamsi va duhaa haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Quyosh bilan va uning ziyosi bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val qamari izaa talaa haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Uning ortidan keladigan Oy bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vannahaari izaa jallaa haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaili izaa yag'shaa haa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u.

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَمَا بَنَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vassamaaa'i va maa banaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va osmon bilan va uning bino qilinishi bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val ardi va maa tahaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va yer bilan va uning to'shalishi bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va nafsinw va maa savwaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va nafs bilan va uning bekam-ko'st qilib yaratilishi bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa-alhamahaa fujuurahaa va taqvaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, u.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Qad aflaha man zakkaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq, kim u.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ دَسَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va qad xaaba man dassaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va batahqiq, kim u.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Kazzabat Samuudu bi tag'vaahaaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Samud qavmi o'z tug'yoni ila.

ayahs.arabic: إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Izim ba'asa ashqaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Vaqtiki,.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Faqaala lahum Rasuulul laahi naaqatal laahi va suqiyaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, ularga Allohning Rasuli «Allohning tuyasiga va uning suviga tegmanglar», dedi.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fakazzabuuhu fa'aqaruuhaa fadamdama 'alaihim Robbuhum bizambihim fasaw vaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, uni yolg'onchiga chiqarishdi va ul(tuyani) so'yishdi.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَاهَا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va laa yaxaafu'uqbaahaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va U zot bu ishning oqibatidan qo'rqmaydi.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vallaili izaa yag'shaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Tunning qoplab kelayotgan payti bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَالنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vannahaari izaa tajalla.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Nahorning tajalli payti bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa xalaqaz zakara val unsaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Erkak va urg'ochining yaratilishi bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna sa'yakum lashattaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, sizlarning ishlaringiz turlichadur.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَاتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa ammaa man a'taa vattaqaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo kimki (ato) bersa va taqvo qilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va saddaqa bil husnaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va go'zal(so'z)ni tasdiq qilsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fasanu yassiruhuu lilyusraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Biz uni osonga muyassar qilamiz.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ بَخِلَ وَاسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ammaa mam baxila vastag'naa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo kimki baxillik va istig'no qilsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِالْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va kazzaba bil husnaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va go'zal(so'z)ni yolg'onga chiqarsa.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fasanu yassiruhuu lil'usraa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Biz uni qiyinga muyassar qilamiz.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa yug'niy 'anhu maaluhuuo izaa taraddaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U qulagan vaqtda unga mol-mulki foyda bermas.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna 'alainaa lal hudaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, hidoyatga boshlash Bizning zimmamizdadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْآخِرَةَ وَالْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va inna lanaa lal Aaxirata val uulaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, ham oxirat va ham bu dunyo Biznikidir.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, Men sizlarni.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَصْلَاهَا إِلَّا الْأَشْقَى
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U(o't)ga badbaxtdan boshqa hech kim kirmas.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy kazzaba va tavallaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: O'sha yolg'onga chiqargan va yuz o'girgan edi.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا الْأَتْقَى
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va sa yujannnabuhal atqaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va albatta, undan taqvodor banda chetda qoladi.

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy yu'tiy maalahuu yatazakkaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U boyligini sarflaydi va o'zini poklaydi.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِنْدَهُ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va maa li ahadin 'indahuu min ni'matin tujzaaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Unda biror kishining qaytarilishi lozim yaxshiligi yo'q edi.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ الْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Illab tig'aaa'a vajhi Robbihil a 'laa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Faqatgina oliy maqom Robbisining roziligini so'rab qiladi.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va lasavfa yardaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va u albatta tezda rozi bo'ladi.

ayahs.arabic: وَالضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vad duhaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Choshgoh bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Val laili iza sajaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sukunatga cho'mgan tun bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ma vad da'aka Robbuka va ma qalaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Robbing seni tark qilmadi va g'azab ham qilmadi.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَلْآخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنَ الْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Valal-aaxiratu xairul laka minal-uula.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, albatta, oxirat sen uchun bu dunyodan yaxshidir.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va la savfa y'utiyka Robbuka fatarda.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va tezda Robbing senga ato qiladir va sen rozi bo'lursan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًا فَآوَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam ya jidka yatiyman fa aavaa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U seni yetim topib, joylab qo'ymadimi?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَالًّا فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va va jadaka daal lan fahada.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va U seni hayron topib, hidoyatga boshlamadimi?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَائِلًا فَأَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va va jadaka 'aa-ilan fa ag'naa.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va U seni kambag'al topib, boy qilmadimi?

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa am mal yatiyma fala taqhar.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Ammo yetimga qahr qilma.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا السَّائِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va am mas saa-ila fala tanhar.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, ammo, «soil»ga zajr qilma.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va amma bi ni'mati Robbika fahad dis.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va, ammo, Robbingning bergan ne'mati haqida so'zla.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Alam nashrah laka sadrak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Sening ko'ksingni keng qilib qo'ymadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنْكَ وِزْرَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va va d'ana 'anka vizrak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va sening yukingni yengillatmadikmi?

ayahs.arabic: الَّذِي أَنْقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Allaziy anqada zahrak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: U sening yelkangni bosib turgan edi.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va raf 'ana laka zikrak.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va sening zikringni yuqori ko'tardik.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa inna ma'al usri yusra.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Bas, albatta, bir qiyinchilik bilan osonchilik bordir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.uzbekReading: Inna ma'al 'usri yusra.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Albatta, bir qiyinchilik bilan osonchilik bordir.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَانْصَبْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fa iza farag' ta fansab.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Forig' bo'lsang, ibodatiga uringin.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَارْغَبْ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va ilaa Robbika far g'ab.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va faqat Robbingga rag'bat qil.

ayahs.arabic: وَالتِّينِ وَالزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Vat tiyni vaz zaituun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Anjir bilan qasam va zaytun bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va tuuri siniyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va Turi Siyno bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ الْأَمِينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Va haazal balad-il amiyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Va mana bu, eminlik yurti (Makka) bilan qasam.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ فِي أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Laqad xalaqnal insaana fiy ahsani taqviym.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Batahqiq, Biz insonni eng yaxshi suratda yaratdik.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَاهُ أَسْفَلَ سَافِلِينَ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Summa ra dad naahu asfala saafiliyn.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: So'ngra uni asfala safilinga qaytardik.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Ill-lal laziyna aamanuu va 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun g'airu mamnuun.
ayahs.uzbekTranslation: Magar iymon keltirganlar va yaxshi amallar qilganlarga minnatsiz va uzluksiz ajrlar bordir.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِالدِّينِ
ayahs.uzbekReading: Fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid diyn.
